_readme: Voice casting for the recorded voice pack. provider: 'openai' (needs OPENAI_API_KEY) or 'elevenlabs' (needs ELEVENLABS_API_KEY; replace each voice with an ElevenLabs voice ID). 'direction' is acting guidance sent with each line (OpenAI only).

gm.direction: A warm, wise fantasy storyteller and game master. Unhurried, gently dramatic, a twinkle of humor.

Brannoc.direction: A gruff, laconic veteran soldier. Low, gravelly, few words, dry humor, protective.

Tamsin.direction: A warm, kind young priestess. Gentle but firm, scolds with affection, brave.

Quillan.direction: An excitable, talkative elven scholar. Quick, enthusiastic, slightly nasal, loves big words.

Pip.direction: A cheeky, playful halfling thief. Bright, quick, mischievous, always joking.

hero_a.direction: A brave adventurer with a deep, steady voice.

hero_b.direction: A brave adventurer with a warm, confident voice.

hero_c.direction: A brave adventurer with a bright, lively voice.

hero_d.direction: A brave young adventurer with a high, eager voice.

goblin.direction: A silly, screechy, gleefully menacing little goblin. Fast, high, cackling, sing-song.

ripnugget.direction: A pompous goblin chieftain, shrill and boastful, shouting.

erylium.direction: A tiny, giggling, wicked imp demon. Hissing, high, gleeful.

beast.direction: A snarling monster. Growl and hiss the words.

tsuto.direction: A bitter, arrogant young man. Cold, sneering, wounded pride.

bruthazmus.direction: A hulking, mocking bugbear hunter. Deep, slow, menacing laughter.

orik.direction: A calm professional mercenary. Matter-of-fact, unbothered.

lyrie.direction: An impatient, condescending scholar-wizard. Clipped and irritated.

nualia.direction: A tragic, furious fallen priestess. Intense, haunted, venomous.

thug.direction: A rough street thug. Threatening, swaggering.
